summary: End-to-end validation of 4-phase Saleable-Stock + Borrowed-source + Dashboard-widget feature. All 9 requested checks PASS. Backend regression suite (test_referral_flat_payout_scoping + test_referral_ha_wing_bucketing + test_referring_doctor_autofill) = 10/10 pass. GET /api/referrals/dashboard returns HTTP 200 with diagnostics_payout/ha_payout/total_payout keys for both owner@thesoundclinic.in (5 rows) and dltest@example.com (6 rows, non-zero HA payouts on linked doctors). GET /api/ha/saleable-stock returns 28 items + totals; GET /api/ha/borrowed-attention returns {count:0,top:[]}. Frontend: Catalogue New-Product modal has NO Cost field and shows the ha-pf-saleunit dropdown with Single/Pair/Kit — product saved with sale_unit=kit and KIT badge appears in table. /ha/saleable-stock loads with all 5 KPIs, 28 rows, and all source/state/testid selectors present. Adding a borrowed unit correctly requires and displays borrowed_from + reason, shows red BORROWED badge and source-clinic text on the row. Return-to-Source modal opens with serial pre-displayed, and after confirm the row disappears. Validation: attempting to save a borrowed unit with empty Borrowed-from keeps modal open and shows inline error 'Borrowed units need a "Borrowed from" (source clinic)'. Main Dashboard Needs-Attention row now shows 4 chips (na-recalls, na-low-stock, na-repairs, na-borrowed); clicking na-borrowed routes to /ha/saleable-stock?source=borrowed as specified.

issues: Table still shows a ₹0 column next to the Sale Unit badge (see row: '₹2,30,000 KIT ₹0 24'). Likely a leftover cost column header/cell rendering 0 after the cost field was removed. Cosmetic — not blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: On Catalogue table, remove the residual '₹0' cost column now that Cost has been replaced by Sale Unit (Phase A) — currently every row renders a ₹0 alongside the KIT/PAIR/SINGLE badge.

OPTIONAL/CLEANUP: E2E created one Catalogue product (Brand=GnResound, Model=iAX50-E2E-43b00f) that could not be deleted via a public DELETE endpoint (no /api/ha/products/{id} DELETE found). Consider adding a delete endpoint or manually purging from the sound-clinic tenant.
critical_code_review_comments: SaleableStockPage.jsx reads `data.totals` — API returns `totals` (not `kpis`) — consistent, no drift, good.
Referral dashboard regression fix (iteration_57) verified holding: 200 OK + payout keys for both tenants.
The 500s observed on /patients, /ha/inventory, /ha/amc are HA-fittings XHR failures pre-existing and flagged in iteration_57 — unrelated to this build (as noted by main agent).
